name: Frost-Skaer Blood-Raiders
identity: Runic berserkers, shield-walls, frost-bear riders and war-mammoths. The army improves permanently by completing public Sagas mid-battle, so both players fight over whether the deed happens.

rules.name: Sworn Sagas
rules.description: Three public Sagas; each unlocks a permanent army-wide rune the moment it is completed: Saga of the Warrior-Born (destroy an enemy Leader) → melee [STRIKE FIRST] on a round your unit charged; Saga of the Beast-Slayer (destroy a Class 4–5 unit) → melee weapons gain [IMPALING HITS]; Saga of the Bear (a unit below Half-Strength survives a round) → UNYIELDING 6+.

rules.name: Gamble — Death-Saga Boast
rules.description: Command Phase: one Leader boasts a deed for this round (destroy a named enemy unit, or control a named objective). Success: +1 CP and that Leader gets +1 Attack for the rest of the battle. Failure: the Leader and its attached unit are Rattled. (Risk: tempo.)

detachments.name: Saga of the Hunt
detachments.playstyle: Fast packs and riders hunting leaders.

rules.name: Berserker Fury
rules.description: Units below Starting Strength (or damaged) get +1 Attack in melee; Leaders get +2.

enhancements.name: Hunter's Torc
enhancements.description: **Jarl Saga-Lord** only. The attached unit gets +1 Attack in melee.

stratagems.name: Runic Brand of the Wolf
stratagems.effect: It may Move and then Charge this activation.

stratagems.name: Blood in the Snow
stratagems.effect: One friendly unit within 6″ heals D3 MIGHT.

detachments.name: Saga of the Storm
detachments.playstyle: Shamans and shield-walls advancing under the blizzard.

rules.name: Blizzard
rules.description: Frost-Shaman Howling Blizzard range is 9″; enemy units more than 18″ away cannot target Frost-Skaer Class 1–2 units.

enhancements.name: Storm-Rune Staff
enhancements.description: **Runic Frost-Shaman** only. The attached unit has WARD 5+.

stratagems.name: Whiteout
stratagems.effect: Until the End of Round, enemy ranged attacks beyond 12″ suffer −1 to Hit.

stratagems.name: Frozen Ground
stratagems.turn: An enemy unit within 9″ of a Shaman declares a Charge

stratagems.name: Hail of Spears
stratagems.turn: A unit shoots at a unit within 8″

detachments.name: Mammoth Stampede
detachments.playstyle: Giants, mammoths and chariots in a single crushing wave.

rules.name: Stampede
rules.description: Class 3–5 Frost-Skaer units get +1″ MOV and their Crushing Impact rolls get +1.

enhancements.name: Beast-Caller's Horn
enhancements.description: **Skald of the Long Hall** only. Friendly Class 3–5 units within 9″ get +2″ to Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Trumpeting Charge
stratagems.turn: A Class 4–5 unit declares a Charge

stratagems.name: Crushing Weight
stratagems.turn: A Class 3–5 unit triggers Crushing Impact
